_notes: All runs use single-eye tower mode, binary eval, 10x5 rep-CV.
common_args are prepended to every run's args list.
Entries marked 'needs_implementation' require small code changes before running (noted inline).
Bridge fusion uses elementwise product of projected image/clinical features.
SE infrastructure exists in Bridge/ImageTower/ClinicalTower but use_se is hardcoded False
in SingleEyeHT — add --se-img-tower / --se-cd-tower / --se-bridge flags to wire through.
Dropout is hardcoded: Bridge classifier=0.5, ClinicalTower=0.1 — add --bridge-dropout /

baseline.description: Fused bridge (image+clinical), BCD p=0.5, cd_warmup=40, tower/fused warmup=3/3, no SE, no IOP correction.
